# Rosso Consulting

> Rosso Consulting is the personal advisory practice and venture lab of Marco Rosso, based in Lugano, Switzerland. Marco works on hospitality technology from three sides: operator, advisor and builder. Signature: "Tried before advised." Every recommendation rests on something he has run, sold, built or tested.

For hotel technology founders, and for hotel owners who want to make real use of what comes next, Rosso Consulting is the personal advisory practice of Marco Rosso: an operator who spent a decade inside hotel technology and now builds with AI himself.

- Operator: Chief Digital Strategy & Business Automation Officer at Planhotel Hospitality Group since 2024.
- Advisor: advisory roles with Canary Technologies (GTM Strategic Advisor), RoomPriceGenie, LobbyAI and Snapfix (Advisory Board), after nearly a decade in commercial roles at Triptease, SiteMinder, Cloudbeds and Canary Technologies, from account executive to global director.
- Builder: founded Astia Web, a website service for hotels and small businesses, built and run with AI. Brand and website work for Hotel Association Zanzibar, THE VIEW Lugano and Francorosso, made with the same method.

Relationships are disclosed and nothing is resold. Consulting prices are not published; every engagement is scoped in conversation and quoted as a fixed fee. The first conversation is unbilled and takes about thirty minutes.

## Offers

- [Advisory](https://rossoconsulting.ch/advisory/): Recurring advice for hotel technology founders, leadership teams and investors: product, go-to-market, positioning and introductions. Formats: advisory board seat, strategic GTM advisor, investor support, talks and panels.
- [AI in Practice](https://rossoconsulting.ch/ai-in-practice/): Hotels get real work done with AI, and keep the method. Start (AI Opportunity Workshop, half a day), Build (fixed-scope modules: Brand Bible, SOP Library, Distribution Consistency Audit, Guest Sentiment Report, Search & AI Visibility Audit, custom workflows), Stay (monthly AI Advisory). A person who knows hotels checks every AI output.
- [The Lab](https://rossoconsulting.ch/lab/): Where Marco tries what AI makes possible before recommending it. Items carry a status: Testing, Live or Venture. Current venture: Astia Web, "A Rosso Consulting company".

## Read

- [Notes](https://rossoconsulting.ch/notes/): Field Notes (short notes on what was tried, what worked and what did not) and essays.
- [The Rate Parity Trap](https://rossoconsulting.ch/writing/rate-parity-trap/): How OTA promotions quietly eat direct bookings while hotels maintain parity.
- [Your hotel is winning the click, and losing the booking](https://rossoconsulting.ch/writing/winning-the-click/): Why the OTA-versus-direct conversion gap is a product problem, not a pricing problem.
- [The one skill that will define luxury hotel leadership in the AI era](https://rossoconsulting.ch/writing/luxury-skill-ai-era/): Judgement about what stays human, what becomes AI-assisted and what is given over.
- [Online vs offline](https://rossoconsulting.ch/writing/online-vs-offline/): Why hotels undervalue the offline channel, with context from the Francorosso heritage.
